verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented New Relic feature for viewing its own observability spend, attributing ingest cost to teams or services, or alerting on usage spikes before billing. The only spend claim (docs-15) concerns multi-cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure spend, which is a different capability. NRQL alerts and dashboards are generic building blocks rather than a cost-attribution feature, and the community's Data Management Hub mention covers only toggling log settings.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
